newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts UST Inc.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts UST Inc.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Diana Temple downgraded UST Inc to hold from buy.

-- Earlier UST said unit volume for the fourth quarter fell about 3.0 percent from the same period in 1995, while unit volume for the full year fell about 2.0 percent, including the effect of an additional shipping day.
-- Temple cut her 1996 earnings per share forecast on UST to $2.42 from $2.45 and dropped her 1997 view to $2.65 from $2.70.
-- "We see the stock as a lackluster performer," Temple said in a report.
